attacks.argument: The claim regarding Asgard's wheat import loss is based on retracted evidence, specifically ORV-0019#P4, which is not admissible.
The cited document ATL-0006#P2 does not mention Asgard or Wheat, rendering it irrelevant to support the claim.
The evidence ORV-0031#P7 does not pertain to Asgard or Maize, thus failing to substantiate the claim regarding alternative suppliers.
